scope: 9 representative existing consumer card products across 7 issuer/product families; not all issuer products
guardrails: Unknown is not false or zero.
All benefit automatic_item_eligibility_enabled=false until the complete executable eligibility/exclusion pack is reviewed.
Foreign fees with null value must not be imputed as zero.
Account APR, grace period, credit availability, cap use, activation and offer eligibility are personal state, not product constants.
No quarterly bonus without verified date-specific category snapshot.
All reward rate rules here are exclusive total rates, not additive bonus rates.
Only verified eligible net purchases qualify; no blanket classification of every online transaction.
Portal promotions, welcome spend bonuses and statement-credit offers are not implemented by this seed.
